meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上插件后，Codex 会自动读取并注入项目规则：在会话开始和用户提交时注入静态指令，在 apply_patch 后注入文件匹配规则；动态输出作为附加上下文注入并按会话去重，不重写工具输出。支持 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等来源和环境变量控制。
howto.when: 在每次会话开始、用户提交提示、以及 Codex 执行 apply_patch 后自动触发；当用户询问 Codex Rules 行为、规则文件位置、匹配或环境配置时也会作为知识源。

say.text: Codex 支持哪些项目规则文件位置？
请解释 CODEX_RULES_MODE 的选项和用途。
当前会话注入了哪些规则？

howto.what_en: When enabled, Codex auto-injects static project rules on session start and user prompt submit, and file-specific rules after apply_patch. Dynamic PostToolUse output is added as context (deduplicated per session); tool output is not rewritten. Supports multiple sources and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically on session start, user prompt submit, and after apply_patch. Also used when users ask about Codex Rules behavior, rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which project rule file locations does Codex support?
Which rules are injected in this session?
